resources.string: Mark messages with saved previous versions
Delete the saved versions in this view? Telegram messages will not be deleted. This cannot be undone.

Tetogram will keep message versions locally, including your own edits and a previous version still in the Telegram cache. Text removed by an edit can remain on this device. This may conflict with Telegram API rules. Secret chats, disappearing messages, one-time media and protected content are excluded. Nothing is uploaded elsewhere. Saving starts only after you enable it; disabling does not erase existing versions. Use Clear edit history to erase them. The retention period and excluded chats are shared with local message history.

Local versions only. Long-press a message → Edit history. Missing versions cannot be restored; the latest saved text may differ from the server if saving was off or updates were missed. Attachments are not downloaded automatically. Retention and excluded chats follow the local history settings.
No saved versions. Enable edit history before the next edit. Earlier text is unavailable if the client never saved or cached it.
